thread:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a small but concrete runbook/playbook update set. Main gaps: unclear gitops workflow for runbook changes, missing QA dry-run steps, and no explicit owner rotation for the remediation sprint.
Igor Petrov: Agree. The runbook edits should be via a guarded branch + staged publish. We don't want hotfixes merged directly to main at 2am.
Samantha Lee: Strong yes. Suggest guarded branch name pattern: runbook/incident-<id>-patch. PR must include a short QA checklist and at least one approval from runtime or oncall.
Eli Nguyen: I'll implement the QA checklist and own the guard-branch process. Proposed checklist items:
1) dry-run in staging with lowered GC threshold
2) run the triage commands and mark outputs
3) confirm revert snippet works
Due: 2026-03-30.
Maya Chen: Concrete triage commands to include in runbook (copy/paste friendly):
```
# eviction rate
curl -s http://metrics.internal/kvcache?model=foo | jq .evictions_per_min
# canary quick probe
curl -sS http://canary.inference/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .status
# isolate shard
rbctl shards set --model foo --state isolate --shard SHARD_ID
```
Samantha Lee: Add thresholds next to commands. My suggestion: evictions_per_min > 80 -> start triage; >180 -> escalate runtime lead; canary status != 200 -> do not promote.
Igor Petrov: I'll add a small decision tree image to the runbook appendix mapping thresholds -> actions (isolate shard vs failover).
runbook-bot: Created RB-4501 "Runbook gitops + QA checklist + owner rotation" assigned to Eli Nguyen. Due 2026-03-30.
Eli Nguyen: Plan: create guarded branch, push edits, run staging reproduction, add "verified" tag to docs, then request Jo/Igor review. Will post PR link here.
Maya Chen: Owner rotation: rotate the runbook oncall owner weekly for 6 weeks and add the rotation table to the appendix. That should spread knowledge and reduce bus factor.
Samantha Lee: Also include a short revert section per change with exact commands (kubectl rollout undo, rbctl route restore). We need copy/paste lines.
Igor Petrov: Small ask: link prior incident IDs (2395000001, 2401000111) in the runbook "known patterns" so reviewers see recurrence.
Maya Chen: Recap owners & dates: Eli -> edits + QA (2026-03-30). Igor -> decision tree + incident links (2026-03-28). Sam -> thresholds & revert snippets (2026-03-27). runbook-bot -> keep RB-4501 until merged.
Samantha Lee: I'll also add a one-paragraph blurb for oncall: "If unsure, page runtime lead; don't promote canary if probe fails" — simple and actionable.
Eli Nguyen: Will open guarded branch this afternoon and ping PR link here.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Once PR merged, I'll update the postmortem action table and close related tasks. :white_check_mark:
